title: Cohomology with support in a closed subscheme agrees between the Zariski and etale topologies for quasi-coherent coefficients
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a closed subscheme Z of a scheme X and a quasi-coherent module F, the cohomology with support H^q_Z(X, F) agrees with H^q_Z(X_etale, F^a), and that when the complement of Z is retrocompact the sheaf i_*H^q_Z(F^a) is quasi-coherent and equals the associated sheaf of i_*H^q_Z(F) (statement lines 14155-14168). The proof (proof lines 14170-14187) compares the long exact sequences for cohomology with supports, using the agreement of Zariski and etale cohomology for quasi-coherent modules, and then applies the quasi-coherence of the higher direct images of a quasi-compact open immersion together with the support triangle. H2: two arguments with several independent inputs, written out in full.
